meta.title: Grid Collection — a puzzle universe of 95,000 levels
meta.desc: One rule, eight directions, 95,000 levels. Grid Collection is the mobile puzzle where you fill every cell with one unbroken chain.
hero.eyebrow: A puzzle game for iPhone and Android
hero.tagline: One rule, eight directions, 95,000 levels. Fill every orange cell with a single unbroken chain.
hero.hint: Click anywhere to make a wave
rule.lead: Start on any cell. Every move jumps a fixed distance. The goal: fill every active cell with one single chain.
rule.straightText: Up, down, left or right; over the two cells in between.
rule.diagText: On the four diagonals; over the single cell in between.
rule.note: Whether the cells you jump over are filled or empty doesn't matter.
rule.hint: Tap one of the dashed cells.
rule.dead: The chain is stuck. That's the whole game: seeing the path ahead.
play.lead: Real levels straight from the game. Every one can be filled to 100%, but not every path gets you there.
play.start: Tap any orange cell to begin.
play.going: Dashed cells are where you can go. Filled: {p}%.
play.hintUsed: The right starting cell is placed. The rest is up to you.
play.perfect: 100% without a single undo: the perfect badge is yours.
journey.unlock: Each size unlocks with 300 stars on the one before.
journey.d5: The warm-up. Teach the rule to your fingers.
journey.d7: Now you think five moves ahead, not one.
journey.d8: The chain grows, the margin for error shrinks.
journey.d9: Patience and planning. Every corner can be a trap.
journey.d10: For masters: one chain through up to 90 cells.
journey.exDesc: No hints, no blocked cells. Keep scrolling: this 20×20 board solves itself in 400 moves.
count.p2: Six sizes, 55 stages. Easy to hard.
count.sub: 95,000 dots, each one a level. Scatter them with your cursor.
count.label: {n} levels
f1.d: One star at 80%, two at 90%, three at 100%. Finish without an undo and the perfect badge is yours too.
f2.d: Stuck? The right starting cell, or 25%, 50% or 75% of the solution, is one tap away.
f3.d: A surprise box every 24 hours: coins or a helper tool.
f4.d: An extra reward every 5 levels: coins, timed unlimited lives or a tool pack.
f5.d: Race the world with your progress score on Game Center.
f6.d: Every grid is split into stages by active-cell count. Difficulty climbs step by step.
f7.d: No sign-up, no password. Game Center signs you in automatically and backs up your progress.
f8.d: From Turkish to Japanese, play in 16 languages.
cta.text: Grid Collection is free on the App Store. The Android version is on its way.
